blindSummary: This state/province showed no region-specific differences from the country dossier: no local ordinance, incident or enforcement pattern unique to it was found in research, so the country-level evidence applies here as it does everywhere.
blindSourceSummaries: A national news site (20 Feb 2025): the women and family commission of parliament unanimously approved a bill barring trans people from restrooms of the sex other than their birth sex (two bills by governing-bloc legislators), with exceptions for custody situations, medical care, and accompanying elderly, under-12 or disabled people; the initiative also requires removing restroom signage ambiguous about who may enter. The trigger was a July 2023 complaint about gendered toilet labels at an international airport. National law - applies in this state/province as everywhere; still requires full plenary approval.

A national human-rights institute analysis (15 April 2025), 'legalised discrimination': on 2 April 2025 parliament's plenary approved, waiving a second vote, a children's sexual-rights law, fused by the women and family commission with the trans bathroom-restriction bills; critiques the measure as institutionalised discrimination against trans people under national human-rights standards.

A regional rights-monitoring organisation's annual report (22 July 2024) records 54 LGBT+ killings and 170 rights violations 2020-2023, trans women the most affected (30 of 54), gay men 23, one lesbian; 19 homicides in 2023 alone (12 trans women, 7 gay men). Documents the Feb 2023 abduction of a 31-year-old trans sex worker from the capital's centre by an organised street gang and her murder in the same metropolitan area with about 30 gunshot wounds, within a pattern of gang extortion of sex workers. National stats - no department-specific cut.
